rule_or_requirement: An activated pixel-risk mechanism must preserve or improve valid completion before lap-time gains count.
observable_information: Frozen grayscale frame stack, inherited action, per-cell valid finish flag, lap time, progress, collision, damage and action latency.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Compare four frozen action safeguards around the exact stable-risk control without changing checkpoint, source, threshold, environment or evaluation cells.
expected_success_endpoint: At least one candidate finishes more of twelve matched cells, or ties completion with shorter median finished lap and no unacceptable candidate-only failure.
control: Stable-risk envelope source SHA-256 31eed1bc0e566d89b7b1d5fc33cb1f28f7662f383e1ae21f7ae814142997c86b over selected full-road-guard checkpoint.
falsifier: Lower completion than control, or completion tie with non-improving finished-lap median, or zero intervention activation.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Five arms on tracks 1-3 and untouched seeds 344-347, twelve matched cells per arm.
resource_and_risk_gate: One frozen Linux CPU v2 benchmark of 60 episodes, 2,000 decisions each and 1,800 seconds maximum; no official external action.
